patches.defect: Both cleared the whole _visible_edge_ids set, dropping the theta_off hysteresis band for every edge in the room. Unrelated edges being held above theta_off disappeared at the next snapshot, and because the post-loop archive diff was then empty they were never recorded in archivedEdgeIds.
patches.fix: Snapshot each ACTIVE contribution's edge id before the alias mutation and carry _visible_edge_ids / archived_edge_ids through the resulting map. The inverse is one-to-many, so an old edge id carries its state to every successor rather than to whichever contribution was iterated last; inactive contributions are excluded so a retracted one cannot redirect a live edge's hysteresis. Edges untouched by the alias map to themselves and keep their band.

patches.defect: _deactivate only scanned contributions that already existed, so a retraction delivered before the event it targets removed nothing and the target was applied normally on arrival and stayed visible forever.
patches.fix: Record the retracted event id in _retracted_event_ids and honour that tombstone when the target arrives, returning reason=retracted_before_arrival. The event still joins the ledger and advances the watermark; it contributes no evidence.

patches.defect: consumers?.*(?:eat|consume).*producers? had no word boundary after the verb, so the substring 'consume' inside 'consumers' satisfied the verb slot and any message containing consumer-token then producer-token emitted a spurious reversed consumers->producers edge alongside the correct one.
patches.fix: Require a word boundary on both sides of the verb: \b(?:eats?|consumes?)\b. A trailing boundary alone still admitted any word ending in the verb ('heat', 'wheat', 'meat', 'great', 'defeat', 'overeat'). 'Consumers eat producers.', 'Consumers consume producers.' and the zh-Hant branch still match.

claimCeiling: Original engineering synthesis and executable reference; not peer reviewed, not SOTA, not a learning-outcome or production-performance claim.
mutationPolicy: Do not edit this file for behaviour changes beyond the recorded patches. Add wrappers and adapters outside reference/; a changed hash requires a new reference version and a new analysis epoch. Every divergence from sourcePath must be listed in patches with its defect and fix.
